# Madeira Originals

> Creative and print studio in São Vicente, Madeira. Graphic design, custom apparel printing, signage and our own Madeira-inspired collection. 0% tourist trap.

Madeira Originals operates two lanes: a retail apparel line (tees, hoodies, accessories, stickers) and a Production Studio offering DTF printing, UV DTF stickers, custom apparel, and rally/performance graphics for businesses and teams.

## Languages

The site is bilingual and uses path-based locales:

- Portuguese (pt-PT) is the default and lives at the root — e.g. `/shop`.
- English lives under an `/en` prefix — e.g. `/en/shop`.
- Slugs are identical in both trees; only the prefix changes.
- Legacy `?lang=en` / `?lang=pt` URLs redirect to their path-based equivalent.

The page list below shows the Portuguese (root) URLs. Prefix any of them with `/en` for the English version.

## Pages

- [Madeira Accessories](/madeira-accessories): Caps, totes, beanies, and small island essentials.

- [Culture](/culture): Stories and inspiration from Madeira.
